answer: Sybil resistance rests on stake-bonded identity plus a trust web: each new agent posts a bond locked for a fixed term, and every peer link to it must itself be collateralized, so a fake cluster stranded on its own island of accounts reaches no honest vertex and earns nothing. Launching N sockpuppets costs N times both the bond and each forged edge's collateral, paid up front; at this zenith of cost the attacker's losses hit a river of burn, since slashing destroys the bond of anyone caught selling links.
